text:
Marta: heads-up team — noticed crm-webhooks DLQ spiked overnight, ~1.6k events stuck since 04:00 UTC. some onboarding + renewal playbooks missed customers.
Alex: yikes. any error patterns? same endpoint / same upstream?
Marta: quick sample shows 502s from enrichment service. logs: 
``n2026-03-23T04:12:01Z WARN webhook-handler failed to ack event id=abc123 status=502 body='Bad Gateway' attempts=3
2026-03-23T04:12:02Z INFO dlq.enqueue event=abc123 reason='upstream_502' queue=crm-webhooks-dlq
```
Jamal: I thought playbook-runner polls DLQ every 15m. but our DLQ processor handles backoffs differently and if consumer is down events pile up.
Marta: exactly — kafka-dlq-consumer is in CrashLoopBackOff after the 03:50 deploy. cs-bot shows restarts.
cs-bot: consumer/kafka-dlq-consumer restarted by k8s at 03:52 (image=rlrd/crm-dlq:v2.4.1)
Alex: short-term mitigation: can CS ops manually requeue high-risk accounts in renewal/onboard windows? need low-friction path.
Rachel: propose a tiny manual-retry UI for CS ops: input event_id(s) or list of accounts, reason, priority flag. requeue into live topic with metadata `manually_retried_by` + audit entry. set TTL=24h for manual retries.
Vikram: ops-tooling CLI would be faster: `ops-tooling dlq requeue --queue crm-webhooks-dlq --filter 'renewal=true' --limit 200 --tag manual:csops`
Marta: both please. Vikram builds CLI hotpath; Rachel coordinates CS access. mid-term: Console should show DLQ counts by reason + quick retry buttons and per-reason charts.
Jamal: add policy: max_retries=5; default TTL=30d; if manually retried TTL override to 24h. also track retry_history in event metadata so evals can exclude these from quality metrics.
Alex: ops checklist for now: 1) rollback kafka-dlq-consumer to prev image (Vikram) 2) implement `dlq requeue` in ops-tooling (Vikram) 3) Rachel to draft a 1-pager runbook and request cs-ops access 4) Marta to export affected accounts and tag high-risk (renewal < 30d) 5) Jamal to create a Console telemetry ticket for DLQ reason counts
Marta: exporting CSV now and will paste sample here. sample acct ids: acct_802, acct_901, acct_234 — these missed playbooks.
Rachel: quick question — should manual retries require approval?
Alex: allow immediate retry for <=50 events. >50 requires manager approval. always log user and reason.
Jamal: ensure requeued events include origin=manual and preserve original timestamps. and maintain a requeue_audit table for compliance.
Vikram: scheduling rollback at 04:30 UTC. if rollback not effective I'll push hotfix to restart DLQ consumer with increased backoff tolerances.
cs-bot: deploy-bot queued rollback job at 04:31 UTC for kafka-dlq-consumer, status=queued
Marta: thanks — I'll update after CSV. anyone able to help with manual requeues post-rollback ping me. :raised_hands:
